title: Q1 – The Mental Model
summary: Understand embeddings as semantic positions in space.
description: Welcome to the Vector Vault. Here, knowledge is stored not just by title, but by meaning. In this quest, you'll learn that a 'vector' is simply a coordinate that represents the theme of a text. 'Closer' coordinates mean 'more similar' meanings.
objective_text: Verify the contents of the Archive and find the position of a celestial fragment.

verification.query: SELECT fragment_id, content, embedding FROM historical_fragments WHERE fragment_id = 1;
